description: A shell script for testing and demonstrating git log options, commit graph creation, and history simplification techniques.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags a git commit with a specified tag.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Generates a list of annotated tags for commits, cleaning up output.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs a git log command with specific formatting and compares output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper for check_outcome to verify successful command execution.
